title: CreateWorkspaceRequest
description: Request object for the CreateWorkspace method.

environmentName.description: The environment for the workbench to create.

workspaceName.description: The name of the workbench to create.

provisionK8sRequest.description: The request for Kubernetes workbench provision. Required in public cloud.

usePublicLoadBalancer.description: The boolean flag to request public load balancer. By default, private load balancer is used.

disableTLS.description: The boolean flag to disable TLS setup for workbench. By default, the TLS is enabled.

enableMonitoring.description: The boolean flag is used to enable monitoring. By default, monitoring is disabled.

enableGovernance.description: Enables Cloudera AI governance by integrating with Cloudera Atlas. By default, this flag is disabled.

existingNFS.description: Optionally use an existing NFS by providing the hostname and desired path (Azure and Private Cloud only).

enableYunikorn.description: The boolean flag is used to enable yunikorn scheduling. By default, yunikorn scheduling is disabled.

loadBalancerIPWhitelists.description: The whitelist of IPs for load balancer.

nfsVersion.description: The NFS Protocol version of the NFS server we are using for Azure and Private Cloud.

enableModelMetrics.description: Enables the model metrics service for exporting metrics for models to a metrics store.

existingDatabaseConfig.description: Optional configurations for an existing Postgres to export model metrics to.

whitelistAuthorizedIPRanges.description: Whether to whitelist only 'authorizedIPRanges' given or all public IPs.

authorizedIPRanges.description: The whitelist of CIDR blocks which can access the API server.

privateCluster.description: Whether to create a private cluster.

subnetsForLoadBalancers.description: The list of subnets used for the load balancer that Cloudera AI creates.

staticSubdomain.description: The static subdomain to be used for the workbench.

cdswMigrationMode.description: Toggle for cdsw migration preflight validation

outboundTypes.description: Outbound Types provided for the workbench.

resourcePoolConfig.description: The resource pool configuration for quota management.

enableEnhancedPerformance.description: Enable Enhanced Performance Mode to maximize throughput and IOPS for root volumes attached to worker nodes.

enableGlobalAccessLoadBalancer.description: Enable global access to the load balancer so the workbench is accessible from other regions.

minInstances.description: The minimum number of instance for auto scaling.

maxInstances.description: The maximum number of instance for auto scaling.

enabled.description: The boolean flag to enable the auto scaling.

AwsCrConfig.description: The capacity reservation config for EKS

network.description: The network config having subnets for AZ

ExistingDatabaseConfig.description: Configurations for bringing an existing database for model metrics

existingDatabaseHost.description: Optionally provide a Postgresql database host to export model metrics to.

existingDatabasePort.description: Optionally provide a Postgresql database port to export model metrics to.

existingDatabaseName.description: Optionally provide a Postgresql database name to export model metrics to.

existingDatabaseUser.description: Optionally provide a Postgresql database user to use when exporting model metrics.

existingDatabasePassword.description: Optionally provide a Postgresql database password to use when exporting model metrics.

secondaryPodRangeName.description: The secondary pod range name for GCP.

InstanceGroup.description: Contains the necessary info for an instance group.

instanceType.description: The cloud provider instance type for the node instance.

instanceTier.description: The tier of the instance i.e. on-demand/spot.

instanceCount.description: The initial number of instance node.

name.description: The unique name for the instance or resource group of the workbench.

ingressRules.description: The networking rules for the ingress.

rootVolume.description: The root volume of the instance.

accelerator.description: The accelerator, which refers to the GPU type configuration.

singleZone.description: The boolean flag to provision single zone or multi zone cluster.

aws.description: The capacity reservation config for EKS.

Network.description: The network config for capacity reservation.

subnets.description: The array of subnets for AZ

OverlayNetwork.description: Contains the information about overlay network.

plugin.description: The plugin specifies specific cni vendor, ex: calico, weave etc.

gcp.description: The networking options for GCP platform.

ProvisionK8sRequest.description: Request object for workbench provision. Required in public cloud.

environmentName.description: The name of the environment for the workbench to create.

tags.description: Tags to add to the cloud provider resources created. This is in addition to any tags added by Cloudera.

network.description: The overlay network for an AWS Kubernetes cluster's CNI.

ProvisionTag.description: Contains a single tag entry that will be configured on cloud resources associated with a workbench.

ResourcePoolConfig.description: Resource pool configuration for quota management.

parentPoolName.description: The name of the parent resource pool.

RootVolume.description: Configuration for instance root device volume.
